text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
As for your present, there's the Kansai 
souvenir from the other day, and then—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
A local racing newspaper. Hehe, what do 
you think? Does it meet your high 
standards?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A local racing paper...!? Ah, ! I'm so 
happy...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too! I bought some racing 
magazines from overseas!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Also, I took pictures of the Umamusume 
over there, and pictures of the racetracks 
too!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I managed to take tons of photos of places 
you'd never see in a magazine~♪

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
My, photos from the actual site...!? It 
really feels as if the atmosphere is 
leaping right out at you...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Thank you both so very much...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Um, first let's make a copy for viewing... 
and make sure the original is securely 
filed away—!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold on, hold on! Mine isn't such an 
amazing photo, so no need to be all formal 
about it!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Not at all! Of course it serves as 
reference material, but I also want to 
preserve the feelings you two put into 
this...!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, if you're gonna be that polite, I 
oughta be the one thankin' you instead. 
Truly, thanks a million!
